name: Combined cycle and HRSG
principle: A gas turbine exhausts at about 600 °C into a heat recovery steam generator (HRSG) that raises steam for a steam turbine, so the plant makes electricity from both cycles. Multi-pressure HRSGs with reheat give the highest efficiency; US EPA reports combined-cycle efficiencies routinely above 55% HHV and 57.1% to 57.9% for GE HA-class units.

process_steps.name: Heat recovery steam generation at one, two or three pressure levels, with optional reheat
